English: Steam Pit
A shallow pit lined with stones, heated by fire and covered with hides. The earliest form of nomadic sauna, offering warmth and simple purification for the clan.
Smoke Tent
A portable tent with a stone hearth and birch branches. The smoke tent serves for cleansing and brief council, improving unity among the people.
Hot Stone Hut
A sturdier, semi-permanent hut built from logs and sod with a stone stove at its heart. Hot stones release steam for ritual purification and communal gatherings.
Wooden Bathhouse
A log bathhouse, roofed and insulated, with benches and a stone stove. The clan can gather here for cleansing, feasts, and important meetings.
Birch Switch Pavilion
A fine pavilion built of timber, featuring benches and stocks of birch switches. The structure encourages ritual purification and supports large clan ceremonies.
Heated Room
A sophisticated, multi-chamber bathhouse with heated floors and walls. The heated room is a symbol of prosperity and advanced craftsmanship in the clan.
Sweat Lodge
A grand sweat lodge, combining the best traditions of the clan. Used for healing, diplomacy, and spiritual rites, drawing travelers and increasing the clans renown.
Family Sauna
Private, well-appointed saunas for every clan family. These foster unity, health, and strong bonds, attracting more people to join the clan.
Community Bath
A vast communal bath complex, open to all members of the clan and visiting guests. Greatly enhances population, unity, and supply for the horde.
Grand Sauna
A legendary sauna complex, a marvel of wood, stone, and art, welcoming all clans and dignitaries. The Grand Sauna is the pride of the horde, a symbol of unity, strength, and cultural supremacy.
